Pick the CSS delivery that fits: one shared sheet for utility classes, or
per-component styles for rules one component owns. The table decides it; the
linked pages do it.

## Decide in one table

A shared stylesheet is one `CSSStyleSheet` object adopted by many shadow
roots. The top three rows deliver one; the bottom two give each component its
own copy.

| Shape                             | Use when                                                                     | What an edit does                             | Page                                                                      |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `?css-sheet`                      | many components share a sheet and you want it cached as its own `.css` asset | restyles every adopter in place, no re-render | [?css-sheet](/vite-plugin-lit/guides/stylesheets/css-sheet/)              |
| `urlSheet()`                      | the same, but you need a custom fetch or code that runs without this plugin  | restyles every adopter in place, no re-render | [urlSheet()](/vite-plugin-lit/guides/stylesheets/url-sheet/)              |
| `?raw` into one shared module     | many components share a sheet and first paint must not flash                 | restyles every adopter in place, no re-render | [Component styles](/vite-plugin-lit/guides/stylesheets/component-styles/) |
| `?hmr-url` `<link>`               | rules one component owns, kept as a real `.css` asset                        | re-renders that component                     | [Component styles](/vite-plugin-lit/guides/stylesheets/component-styles/) |
| `?raw` or `?inline` + `unsafeCSS` | rules one component owns, shipped in the JS chunk                            | re-renders that component                     | [Component styles](/vite-plugin-lit/guides/stylesheets/component-styles/) |

A re-render is cheap for one component's own rules and expensive for a layer
every component adopts. [CSS delivery](/vite-plugin-lit/concepts/css-delivery/)
has the measurements behind that.

## Shared sheet for Tailwind or UnoCSS

A generated utility sheet is the case the top rows exist for. Every component
adopts the same object, so a regenerated file restyles the whole app without
re-rendering anything.

Choose by where the bytes should live. `?css-sheet` and `urlSheet()` keep the
CSS as a separate, content-hashed `.css` asset, at the cost of FOUC: a brief
flash of unstyled content while the stylesheet is still loading. The inline
shared module ships the bytes in a JS chunk. There is no fetch and no flash,
but the CSS is not cacheable on its own.

<Aside type="tip" title="Cancel the flash">
  Add `<link rel="preload" as="style" href="…">` to the document head. The
  fetch is then already in flight when the first component mounts.
</Aside>

## Compose a shared sheet with component styles

`static styles` takes an array, so the two shapes stack. Put the shared sheet
first and the component's own `css` block after it, and the later rules win at
equal specificity.
